Scope and remaining work Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error: Only three fixed scalar grids are checked. Large coefficient jumps, strong anisotropy, elasticity, arbitrary unstructured meshes, optimal complexity and mesh-independent convergence are not certified. A small residual alone does not prove a small solution error. AMG: conditioning, anisotropy, residual and forward error: Only a small constant-coefficient family is checked. Arbitrary coefficient jumps, unstructured grids, indefinite systems, optimal complexity and uniform convergence are outside scope. No claim that anisotropy necessarily increases κ₂ or monotonically worsens convergence. Reference entry points 4. Algebraic Multigrid (1987) Bibliographic and chapter reference links.
